used.text: Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 7.3.3.5.5.5 Operations – Start execution of an operation [SWS_DM_01396] Support of SOVD method Start Execution of an Opera- tion Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ For each DiagnosticSovdOperationStart , the Diagnostic Server in- stance shall provide the SOVD method Start Execution of an Operation ac- cording to ASAM SOVD[5][14]. ⌋ [SWS_DM_02174] Operation start execution Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ If a SOVD method to start an operation is received and, if needed, the proxim- ity_challenge validation according to [SWS_DM_02173] succeeded, the DM shall call the ara::diag::GenericDiagnosticSovdOperation::StartExecution . ⌋ [SWS_DM_02176] Response body of a synchronous operation start Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ If a synchronous SOVD operation has been started, the DM shall return the SOVD response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] and set the parameters attribute to the value derived from the DiagnosticSovdContentData within the returned StartSynchronousExecutionResponse from ara::diag::GenericDiagnos- ticSovdOperation::StartExecution . ⌋ [SWS_DM_02177] Response body of an asynchronous operation start Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ If an asynchronous SOVD operation has been started, the DM shall return the SOVD response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] and set the attributes id to a value provided by the DM to uniquely identify the running operation (concrete value is implementation specific and not defined by AUTOSAR). The id is used as execution-id for capability calls of this operation. status to the value derived from SovdOperationExecution::ExecuteCapa- bility (obtained from returned StartAsynchronousExecutionResponse). ⌋
